import { defineTable, col, rel } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { orders } from "./orders";
import { products } from "./products";

// Introspected as an owned-child: belongs to orders (the leading column of a primary key made only of foreign keys) and nothing else references it.
export const orderDetails = defineTable("order_details", {
    columns: {
        orderId: col.smallint().primaryKey(),
        productId: col.smallint().primaryKey(),
        unitPrice: col.real().notNull(),
        quantity: col.smallint().notNull(),
        discount: col.real().notNull()
    },
    relations: {
        order: rel.belongsTo(() => orders, { onDelete: "no action" }),
        product: rel.belongsTo(() => products, { onDelete: "no action" })
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
